coordinate_system: glTF: metres, +Y up, -Z forward, anatomical right +X
pivot_space: pivot_position is parent-local glTF translation; pivot_model_position is rest-pose model-space origin. Rotations in degrees about local axes; X is every bend/pitch hinge, Y is yaw. Translation ranges are deltas from rest in local metres.
range_semantics: [min,max] inclusive; free means no cap; [0,0] locked. Ranges are artistic guides, not collision guarantees.
